summary: Valyu gives 1,000 free credits a month, or 2,000 when you sign up with a work (company) email. Work-email credits arrive at signup with no card; personal or university email accounts need nothing for the first month, then must add a card on the platform to keep the credits coming (adding a card does not charge it). One shared credit balance covers Search, Contents and DeepResearch. In your first month, the first 1,000 free credits with a work email (500 with a personal email) work on every source on Valyu's standard plans; after that, free monthly credits cover the pay-as-you-go sources (web search, arXiv and PubMed) and a plan unlocks the rest. Licensed sources outside the standard plans still need separate access. Free credits reset each month and unused credits do not roll over. Beyond the free allowance, pay-as-you-go top-ups start at $10 (1,600 credits per $10) and monthly plans unlock more sources. There are no overage charges: when the balance cannot cover a request, the API returns 402 Payment Required and does not run it.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Valyu account; a work (company) email gets 2,000 free credits a month with no card, a personal or university email gets 1,000.

Try Search, Contents and DeepResearch. In your first month, the first 1,000 free credits with a work email (500 with a personal email) work on every standard-plan source; then free monthly credits cover web search, arXiv and PubMed. Licensed sources outside standard plans need separate access.

With a personal or university email, add a card on the platform after your first month to keep the free credits coming (it is not charged). Credits reset monthly with no rollover; when the balance runs out, requests return 402 until the next reset, a top-up ($10 minimum) or a plan.
